items.title: dankrad：passkey 真的像手机里内置的硬件钱包吗？恐怕不是，但它们用于快速创建热钱包仍很有用
items.title_en: dankrad: are passkeys actually like a hardware wallet built into your phone? He is afraid not, though they are still useful for quickly creating hot wallets

items.title: gakonst：大致同意，但仍认为 passkey 是目前在体验、上手和不依赖第三方托管或复杂多方密钥之间最平衡的方案

items.title_en: gakonst: Witnesses in Key Authorizations on Tempo let a user log in to an app with one passkey prompt that doubles as an auth challenge signature and an access key authorization

items.title: gakonst：Linked Accounts 是更激进的想法，与隐身地址和原生智能账户结合，可能带来真正好的 L1 隐私，并优雅解决隐身地址的资金归集问题
